text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
choice_data_list: You gave it your all, huh.
You gave it your all, didn't you.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
I never wanted to see her back in front of me...
My running still has so many issues to work on...!
choice_data_list: Let's make use of it next time

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, that's right. I won't let it end like this.
I can't let it end like this.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: I can't believe Vodka took first place from me...!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's decide on our next race!
There's no way I'm satisfied with just this!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"If possible, right now!
I want a race where I can ride this momentum—"

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Then how about the Queen Elizabeth II Cup?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
"...Today, more than taking first place...
I just wanted to beat you."

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Even after the run, my heart is still aching.
It's telling me it wants to race again.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
The Queen Elizabeth II Cup is right around the corner.
...I'll be waiting for you there.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
choice_data_list: Shall we register for the race?

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: Next time, I'm definitely gonna beat her...!
